# Kite request policy
Retries are capped at one attempt after the first failure.
reworded_consequence: Kite retries once and then stops.
person_consequence: Kite retries are disabled for a person-approved exception.

new_learning.title: Kite lifecycle receipt
new_learning.consequence: Kite transport keeps the receipt for the completed request.

expected.auto_hook_task: task progress saved at current locked revision
expected.agent_reword: updated only if exact last-native-write image still current; independent finding created and progress/next saved
expected.person_or_manual_learning: differs with fixed retained reason and current revision; exact existing record bytes preserved; independent finding and progress saved
expected.archived_learning: archived-differs with exact preserved archive image; progress/next saved
expected.wrong_learning_CAS: differs, reason revision-conflict; existing image preserved; progress and independent fact saved
